qa_pair.question: In the fixed Topo MCP evaluation fixture, inspect all route records and their screen-state relationships. Which state exists alongside the default state on the only route with more than one screen state? Answer with the state name only.

Find the verified critical-path flow, start at its declared entry step, and follow next-step relationships until the route changes. Inspect the component used only by the destination screen. What is that component's preview status?

Compare the unresolved and resolved diagnostic records in the fixed fixture. Follow the higher-severity unresolved record's source file to the screen sourced from that same file. What is the screen title?
Inspect every component and its used-by relationships in the fixed fixture. Which component is reused by the greatest number of distinct screens? Answer with its component name.
Beginning at the public home screen, follow the two high-confidence navigation edges in sequence and inspect the final screen record. What is the final route path?
Inspect the project manifest, profile records, and profile payloads in the fixed fixture. Does any preview-profile record include authentication secrets? Answer true or false.
Find the captured 1440 by 900 snapshot, follow its captures-screen relationship, and inspect that screen's route record. What route path was captured?
Inspect the completed job record and compare its kind with the generated context file catalog exposed by the manifest. What single job kind produced those files?
Find the note attached to the component that lacks a preview. Then inspect the verified flow steps to find the step that references this note. What is that flow-step title?
Inspect the route aggregate whose default screen is already captured but whose alternate state remains unseen. How many screen states does that route expose? Answer with a number only.
